items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And then who after that? Dr. Dr. Ernest. It's Tom Abbott in Barnes. Kid Abbott in Barnes.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. After he played with you, who did he go with?

With me? Yeah. He said, after you finished playing with me, who did you go with? When I finished playing? With me. Let me see. I remember Dr. Ernest. Dr. Ernest. He was playing out of Metro. He was playing with me. He was playing with me. He was playing with me. He was playing out of Metro. And then who? And then who after that? Dr. Dr. Ernest. It's Tom Abbott in Barnes. Kid Abbott in Barnes.
Ask him who played with Dr. Ernest, who was in the band.
